prompts.banner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game UI banner illustration for an original clean comic fantasy tower-defense game. Draw a wide horizontal rust-crimson battle pennant, flat front view, matte deep red cloth with 2-3 broad cel-shaded folds, dark ink contour and restrained warm brass corner bindings. Aspect ratio about 4.8:1, leave transparent generous margins. The banner occupies one single connected shape, clean asymmetric fishtail cuts at the far tips, understated gray iron studs near ends, not ornate. Most of the middle and right is a calm large dark-maroon empty field reserved for engine-rendered text; the left also stays empty because a separate emblem will be placed over it in game. Use warm clear colors, deliberately simple material shapes, broad matte brushwork and confident outlines, same production language as a hand-drawn comic castle game with warm wood, pale stone and blue flags. Silhouette must read at 700x150 screen pixels. No text or letters, no icons, no skulls, no horns, no warning triangles, no diagonal hazard stripes, no gears, no glitch, no neon, no gradients resembling plastic or metal renders, no leaf filigree, no photorealism, no composition from other games. Background must be truly transparent. This is only the empty banner asset, no scene and no mockup.
prompts.crest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent original game UI warning emblem, clean comic fantasy tower-defense style. A compact shield-shaped dark iron war crest with a simple broad warm-brass border, backed by two short crossed battle axes whose silhouettes are deliberately chunky and readable. Central symbol is three broad ivory claw cuts slashing down the shield's muted rust-red face. No skull or face, no horns, no flames, no warning triangle, no crown, no lettering. Flat front view, strong dark ink outline, 2-3 clean cel-shaded planes per material, matte colors and restrained highlights, small softened chips only at edges. The crossed axe blades are pale steel with simple shapes, handles warm brown; crest feels like a hand-drawn castle-defense game's enemy faction insignia. Shape occupies about 85% of square canvas, centered, readable at 160 pixels. Avoid huge bevels, glossy 3D, photoreal textures, jewelry, complicated filigree, electric glow, gears, hazard stripes, commercial game emblems. Transparent background, only the emblem, no ground shadow, no scene or UI mockup.
